summary: The home page is the shop window: it should show what Millbrook sells, today's offers and the way into the departments. It does all of that, but as a 2011 page crammed into a 780 px table: on a phone it is shrunk to 40 %, the offer banner and ticker are from the 2011 Spring Sale, and nothing says why to buy here. The change that matters most: a phone-first page that leads with the departments and one current offer.
audience: Regular customers from the area and new visitors arriving from search, mostly on their phones (the notes say most orders are placed on phones).
tasks: Find the right department or product
See current offers and new arrivals
Check delivery costs and opening hours of the shop

purpose.clear.evidence: The logo says Home & Garden, but the first screen is mostly the sale banner and the sidebar; the welcome text explaining the shop starts below the banner.

purpose.tasks.evidence: Departments and products are reachable, but on a phone every link is tiny (the page is shrunk to 40 %) and the basket only opens a pop-up („javascript:popup('basket')“).

content.complete.evidence: Departments, new products with prices, bestsellers, delivery promise („FREE … on orders over €50“), shop address and opening hours.

content.current.evidence: Banner and ticker advertise the Spring Sale that „ends 30th April 2011“; the newest news item is from 12/03/2011 and the footer says „© 2003-2011“.

content.readable.evidence: The welcome paragraph has 71 words of general phrases („Now you can buy our products online 24 hours a day, 7 days a week!!“) before anything useful.

content.errors.evidence: No spelling errors; a double exclamation mark in the welcome text.

content.duplicate.evidence: The sidebar (departments, special offer, newsletter, news, cards) repeats on every page and takes a third of the width.

structure.scannable.evidence: Section bars (New This Month, Our Bestsellers, Visit Our Shop) help, but the sidebar boxes compete with them and the page has 59 links.

action.primary.evidence: Six „Buy“ buttons, „Shop now »“ in the banner, „Subscribe“ and „GO“: no single main action, and the grid's „Buy“ buttons do nothing.

nav.menu.evidence: Seven green tabs (Home … Sale!) plus a second department list in the sidebar; the current tab is marked yellow, but Delivery, Returns and Contact live only in the footer.

visual.brand.evidence: The green house-and-leaf logo with the italic Millbrook wordmark, dark green #2f5420 / #4c7f2f and cream surfaces: recognisable on every page and fitting for a home and garden shop. Verdana 11 px is just old, not brand.

visual.images.evidence: The product pictures are clean 600 px photos shown at 110 px; the sale banner is a 2.5 MB, 5800 px wide file shown at 580 px, with its text baked into the image.

visual.hierarchy.evidence: Red sale box, yellow ticker, green bars, red prices and orange buttons all shout at once; the eye lands on the banner, then the dashed red „Special Offer!“ box, not on the products.

visual.consistency.evidence: Same frame, nav, sidebar boxes and footer as the other pages.

trust.signals.evidence: „family run business … since 1987“ and the shop photo build trust; The footer names the shop and its street address; there are no reviews, no returns promise near the products and the payment logos are plain text boxes.

inventory.block: Top bar: free delivery and order hotline
inventory.why: The two facts visitors look for; the hotline needs to be a tap-to-call link.

inventory.block: Header: logo, log in, basket, search
inventory.why: Keep logo, basket and search; make them a compact, sticky header that works on phones.
Keep the six departments, as a menu that fits phones.
Out of date and hard to read; one current offer goes in the hero.
Departments into the menu, newsletter into the footer, news and cards dropped from the home page.
A real-text hero with one current offer instead of a 2011 image banner.
One sentence about the family shop since 1987.
A real look inside the shop; give it a proper place next to the shop's address, not between welcome text and products.
The heart of the page: product cards with price and a working add-to-basket.
Merge with the new products into one product row.
Address, opening hours and parking matter for local customers.

inventory.block: Footer with counter and „Best viewed with“
inventory.why: Keep the links; drop the counter and browser notice.

keep: Free delivery over €50 and the order hotline 01632 960 412
Shop address, opening hours and free parking

fix.text: No viewport: phones show the page shrunk to 40 % with 4 px text
Sale banner, ticker and news from 2011
Everything competes for attention; nothing leads
Order hotline is not a tap-to-call link

add: A current offer instead of the 2011 sale
Reasons to buy here near the products: free delivery, 30-day returns, a real shop
Tap-to-call hotline and a link to the shop on a map
design_input: Compact header: logo, search, basket; departments as a menu that fits phones
Hero: one current offer with a real-text headline and one button
New in: product cards (picture, name, price, Add to basket)
Trust strip: free delivery over €50, 30-day returns, family shop since 1987
Visit the shop: photo, address, opening hours, parking
